scripts.wasm: cd vendor/chimera && cargo build -p chimera-wasm --release --target wasm32-unknown-unknown && cp target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/chimera_wasm.wasm src/wasm/chimera.wasm && cp src/wasm/chimera.wasm ../../prebuilt/chimera.wasm
scripts.build: bun run --cwd packages/stage build && bun run build:plugin
scripts.test: bun test packages/core packages/daemon packages/mcp packages/hooks packages/omp
scripts.typecheck: bunx tsc --noEmit -p packages/core && bunx tsc --noEmit -p packages/stage
scripts.build:plugin: bun build packages/mcp/src/server.ts --target bun --outfile plugin/bin/mcp.js && bun build packages/hooks/src/on-event.ts --target bun --outfile plugin/bin/hook.js
